# Beets AI — 香港免費 AI 教育資源 / Free Hong Kong AI Teaching Resources

> A free library of AI teaching resources for Hong Kong primary and secondary
> schools, published by Beets Limited (https://beets3d.com). Every item names the
> official EDB source document it is built on and its version. No sign-up, no paywall.

Traditional Chinese ("zh-HK") is the primary edition at the site root; English is
under /en/. Both editions of an item share one address.

Citation: please attribute to "Beets AI (Beets Limited)" and link the item URL.
Reuse terms: https://beets-ai.com/about/


## Full inventory (both editions)


### S1–S6 全科：學術誠信聲明——我如何在這份功課使用人工智能（四級使用程度、一頁六欄聲明表）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/academic-integrity-ai-use-declaration/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 四級使用程度 L0–L3、一頁六欄、三句虛構示範：學生用三十秒說清楚「哪一級、用在哪一步、怎樣核實與改寫」，教師用一頁說明在三種情境下怎樣用。不計分、不排名，判定權在科組與學校機制。
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: 全科／跨科
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.0
- Sources: 《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》, p.2; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-4; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, p.2-4; EDBCM No. 156/2026（附錄一 第 3 節、第 4 節；附錄二 教師資訊包 四. 重要訊息 4 學生篇）

### S1-S6 cross-subject: the academic integrity declaration — how I used AI on this piece of work (four levels, one page, six columns)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/academic-integrity-ai-use-declaration/
- Language: en
- Description: Four levels, L0 to L3, one page, six columns and three fictional examples: a student says in thirty seconds which level applies, where it was used, and how the work was checked and rewritten. The teacher note covers three situations. Not marked, not ranked, and the judgement stays with the subject panel and the school's arrangements.
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: Cross-subject
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.0
- Sources: Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-4; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2-4; EDBCM No. 156/2026（附錄一 第 3 節、第 4 節；附錄二 教師資訊包 四. 重要訊息 4 學生篇）

### P1–S6 校本規劃：AI 預算與授權規劃工作表（三個錢包、三個成本情境）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/ai-budget-licensing-worksheet/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 一份可計算的校本 AI 預算與授權規劃工作簿：三個錢包分開記錄、三個成本情境用同一組欄位並排、每學生每年成本一條公式、簽約前必問三題，以及四項問責程序的空白時間表。
- Stage: P1-S6
- Subject: 校本規劃
- Theme: A (校本 AI 教育規劃)
- Audience: teachers (教師)
- Version: 1.0
- Sources: 《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》, p.2; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-4; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-2 to 2-5; 通函 156/2026（附錄一 第 2 節）; 通函 107/2026（第 4 段）

### P1-S6 School planning: AI budget and licensing worksheet (three funding sources, three cost scenarios)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/ai-budget-licensing-worksheet/
- Language: en
- Description: A planning workbook that does the arithmetic: three funding sources kept apart, three cost scenarios filled in with the same set of columns, one formula for cost per student per year, three questions to ask before signing, and a blank timetable for the four reporting duties.
- Stage: P1-S6
- Subject: School planning
- Theme: A (校本 AI 教育規劃)
- Audience: teachers (教師)
- Version: 1.0
- Sources: Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-4; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-2 to 2-5; 通函 156/2026（附錄一 第 2 節）; 通函 107/2026（第 4 段）

### S1–S6 全科／跨科：AI 的代價——能源、用水與看不見的勞動，三條線索與三欄表
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/ai-cost-energy-water-labour/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 一條線索一條線索地分開「我們知道」與「我們還不知道」：能源、用水與看不見的勞動，加一張三欄表、一次校內小量度與五條提問，讓學生問得出下一個問題，而不是背一個數字。
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: 全科／跨科
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-4; EDBCM No. 156/2026; 《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》, p.2; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, p.2-2

### S1-S6 cross-curricular: what AI costs — energy, water and unseen labour, in three clues and a three-column table
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/ai-cost-energy-water-labour/
- Language: en
- Description: Taking one clue at a time and separating \"what we know\" from \"what we do not know yet\": energy, water and unseen labour, plus a three-column table, one small class tally and five questions — so that pupils leave with the next question instead of a figure.
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: Cross-curricular
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-4; EDBCM No. 156/2026; Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2-2

### P4–S6 全科／跨科：錯誤分析——AI 錯了，你怎樣發現？（五格記錄、四類錯誤、三句追問）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/ai-error-discovery-log/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 一次只記一個已經發生的錯誤：五格寫完它說了甚麼、我怎樣發現、錯在哪一類、我改了甚麼、下次早一點，再把錯誤歸入四類之一，用三句固定追問講清楚當時為甚麼信、靠甚麼發現。
- Stage: P4-S6
- Subject: 全科／跨科
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.0
- Sources: EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.1 s.3; EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.2 item 4; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-13; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-7 to 2-8

### P4-S6 all subjects: error analysis — when the AI was wrong, how did you find out? (five cells, four error types, three follow-up questions)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/ai-error-discovery-log/
- Language: en
- Description: One error at a time, recorded after the fact in five cells: what it said, how I found out, which type of error it was, what I changed, and one thing I would do earlier next time — then one of four error types and three fixed follow-up questions.
- Stage: P4-S6
- Subject: All subjects / cross-curricular
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.0
- Sources: EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.1 s.3; EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.2 item 4; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-7 to 2-8

### S1–S6 班主任及家長：應對人工智能生成的騷擾——四步處理程序、三類情境與頭二十四小時時序表
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/ai-generated-harassment-response-procedure/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 事情發生時，最先要做的不是查明真假，而是先讓受影響的學生安全。四步次序固定——先保護、保存、通報、處理與記錄；三類情境只分流、不改四步；另附頭二十四小時時序表與家長一頁。
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: 班主任及家長
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師), parents (家長)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: 《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》, p.2; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-4; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-2 to 2-5; EDBCM No. 156/2026（附錄一 第 4 節；附錄二 教師資訊包 四. 重要訊息 4 學生篇）

### S1-S6 Class teachers and parents: responding to AI-generated harassment — a four-step procedure, three situations and a first-24-hours timeline
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/ai-generated-harassment-response-procedure/
- Language: en
- Description: When something happens, the first task is not to establish whether it is true but to make the affected student safe. Four steps in a fixed order — protect, preserve, report, handle and record — with three situations that only route the case, a first-24-hours timeline and a single page for parents.
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: Class teachers and parents
- Theme: B (安全及負責任使用 AI)
- Audience: teachers (教師), parents (家長)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-4; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-2 to 2-5; EDBCM No. 156/2026（附錄一 第 4 節；附錄二 教師資訊包 四. 重要訊息 4 學生篇）

### P1–S6 跨科：AI 融入課堂的觀課與同儕回饋指引（一頁六欄記錄表、三十分鐘回饋會）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/ai-lesson-observation-protocol/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 一份同儕觀課指引：觀課前三項準備、一頁六欄記錄表（環節／AI 用途／教師把關／學生核實／學生原創／一處可改進）、三十分鐘回饋會流程、三個判準，以及與學校自評循環的接合方法。記錄不評分，不與人事評核掛鈎。
- Stage: P1-S6
- Subject: 跨科
- Theme: A (校本 AI 教育規劃)
- Audience: teachers (教師)
- Version: 1.0
- Sources: 《中小學數字教育發展藍圖》, p.2; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-4; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-13; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-2 to 2-5; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-7 to 2-8; EDBCM No. 156/2026; EDBCM No. 107/2026

### P1-S6 across subjects: observing an AI-integrated lesson and giving peer feedback (a one-page six-column record and a 30-minute feedback meeting)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/ai-lesson-observation-protocol/
- Language: en
- Description: A peer-observation guide: three things to settle before the lesson, a one-page six-column record (activity, use of AI, teacher's check, pupil verification, pupil's own work, one thing to improve), a 30-minute feedback meeting, three tests, and how the output joins the school's self-evaluation cycle. Nothing is graded and nothing goes into staff appraisal.
- Stage: P1-S6
- Subject: Across subjects
- Theme: A (校本 AI 教育規劃)
- Audience: teachers (教師)
- Version: 1.0
- Sources: Blueprint for Digital Education Development in Primary and Secondary Schools, p.2; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-4; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-2 to 2-5; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-7 to 2-8; EDBCM No. 156/2026; EDBCM No. 107/2026

### P4–S6 全科／跨科：更好的問題——從 AI 答案提出三個它沒問的問題（一句一行、固定三問、三欄記錄）

- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 把一個 AI 答案切成一句一行（最多五行），再就其中一句提出三個它沒問的問題：它假設了甚麼、沒有提到誰、改一個條件還成立嗎；三欄記錄，最後選一問打回工具，寫一句新答案有何不同。
- Stage: P4-S6
- Subject: 全科／跨科
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)

- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/better-questions-from-ai-answers/
- Language: en
- Description: Split an AI answer into one sentence per line — five lines at most — then ask three questions it did not ask itself about one of those lines: what did it assume, who did it not mention, would it still hold if one condition changed. ### P4-S6 all subjects: exit tickets an AI cannot answer for you — one sheet, three lines, two minutes, five question types, four piles
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/exit-tickets-ai-cannot-answer/
- Language: en
- Description: Two minutes before the bell, pupils write three lines on half a sheet of A5: what I understood today, what I am still unsure about, what our group said. The questions come from five types only, at least two types per ticket; the tickets are sorted into four piles in three minutes (got it, half there, teach again, not answered), and the first five minutes of the next lesson answer the teach-again pile only. No name, no score — class and group only.
- Stage: P4-S6
- Subject: All subjects / cross-curricular
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.2
- Sources: EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.2 s.3; Maths C&A Guide (S4-6), s.5.2; Primary IT Curriculum Framework (AI, pilot), 在小學階段推展人工智能教育; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13

### P4–S6 全科／跨科：AI 無法代答的離場券——一張紙三行、兩分鐘、五類題、四堆分類
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/exit-tickets-ai-cannot-answer/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 打鐘前兩分鐘，學生在半張 A5 上寫三行：我今日明白了⋯／我仍然不確定⋯／我們組講過⋯。題目只從五類之中選，最少跨兩類；收券後三分鐘分四堆（懂了、半懂、要重教、未答），下一節首五分鐘只回應「要重教」那一堆。不記姓名、不評分，只寫班別與組別。
- Stage: P4-S6
- Subject: 全科／跨科

### S1-S6 Visual Arts: likeness and image rights — five judgements, three outcomes, two 60-minute lessons and a one-page image-use declaration
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/likeness-and-image-rights/
- Language: en
- Description: A decision about a generated image of a person is usually made in under a minute: whose face is it, was anyone asked, is the source usable, where will it be shown, and is it labelled. Five judgements in a fixed order resolve into three outcomes — can do, ask first, cannot do — across two 60-minute lessons: identifying and appreciating, then making and declaring.

### S1-S6 all subjects: a metacognitive log — what I knew, what I asked, what I still cannot do (three columns, four boxes on one page, three minutes in each of four lessons, ten minutes in the fifth)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/metacognitive-log-know-asked-not-yet/
- Language: en
- Description: In the last three minutes of each lesson, pupils write three lines in one box of the same sheet: one step I could already take before today, one question I asked today, and the one step I still cannot do. Four boxes fill over four lessons, and the fifth lesson spends ten minutes setting the first box beside the fourth and writing one line — what I have changed. Twenty characters a line at most, no name, no score, and the sheet stays with the pupil for four weeks.
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: All subjects / cross-curricular
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-3; VA Curriculum Guide (P1-S6) 2024, s.5.3; Arts Education KLA Guide (P1-S6) 2017, s.4.3.1; EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.2 s.1

### S1–S6 全科／跨科：後設認知日誌——我已知、我問過、我仍未懂（三欄、一頁四格、四節各三分鐘、第五節十分鐘）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/metacognitive-log-know-asked-not-yet/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 每節最後三分鐘，學生在同一張紙的一格裏寫三句：今日之前我已經懂的、今日我問過的一個問題、我仍未清楚的是。一頁四格，連續四節各寫一格，第五節用十分鐘把第一格與第四格並排，寫一句「我改變的是⋯」。每句上限二十字，不記姓名，不評分，紙張由學生自己保管四星期。
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: 全科／跨科

- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/oral-check-explain-the-idea/
- Language: en

### S1-S6 all subjects: peer critique of one shared AI output — the same five to eight sentences, three sentences each, three comment types, a four-column sheet, one class vote
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/peer-critique-ai-output-shared-object/
- Language: en
- Description: The whole class reads one five-to-eight-sentence output and each pupil critiques three sentences only, choosing one of three comment types per sentence — it holds up, it needs evidence, it does not hold if the object changes — and naming on a four-column sheet which evidence is wanted. Four-person groups argue for five minutes, the class casts one vote for the sentence that most needs evidence, and then the class revises that one sentence. Nothing is scored, nothing is named, and no chat record is collected.
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: All subjects / cross-curricular
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-7 to 2-8; VA Curriculum Guide (P1-S6) 2024, s.4.4.2; Arts Education KLA Guide (P1-S6) 2017, s.5.3; EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.1 s.4; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13

### S1–S6 全科／跨科：以 AI 輸出為共同對象的同儕評議——同一份五至八句、每人只評三句、三類評語、四欄紙、全班一票
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/peer-critique-ai-output-shared-object/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 全班看同一份五至八句的輸出，每人只評三句，每句只在三類評語之中選一類——站得住、要證據、換了對象就不成立——並在四欄紙上寫明要哪一種證據。四人小組辯論五分鐘，全班一票選出最需要補證據的一句，之後只改寫那一句。不評分、不記名、不收任何對話紀錄。
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: 全科／跨科
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.1
- Sources: 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-7 to 2-8; VA Curriculum Guide (P1-S6) 2024, s.4.4.2; Arts Education KLA Guide (P1-S6) 2017, s.5.3; EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.1 s.4; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-13

### S1-S6 Information Technology: personal-data scenarios pack — five situation cards, three questions each, a four-level ladder and a one-page decision table
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/personal-data-scenarios-pack/
- Language: en
- Description: Five situations a school meets every week — a class photo, a parents' group, essays and a class list, results and support records, a graduation photo — and each card asks only three questions: whose data is this, is it identifiable, and is it necessary. A four-level ladder decides whether the material can stay, must be anonymised first, must not be uploaded, or must not go near an AI tool at all.

### P4-S6 all subjects: teach it back — assessed on clarity, not on the answer (a 90-second round, a three-cell clarity card, four clarity standards)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/teach-it-back-clarity-assessed/
- Language: en
- Description: Each pupil draws one tool answer, gets 30 seconds to write three words only, and has 90 seconds to explain it until group members understand; they fill three cells of a clarity card and the speaker explains it again for 90 seconds with no new material. Four clarity standards are posted publicly. Clarity is assessed, not the correctness of the answer; nothing is scored, no oral examination and no report card entry.
- Stage: P4-S6
- Subject: All subjects / cross-curricular
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.0
- Sources: Maths C&A Guide (S4-6), s.5.4.2; Chinese Language Curriculum Guide (P1-6) 2023, Learning Strand 5, item 2, p.20; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-13; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-7 to 2-8; EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.2 s.3

- Version: 1.0
- Sources: EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.1 s.4; AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools (Examples of Application Scenarios), p.13; Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, Supp. II; CDC Maths C&A Guide (S4-S6)

### S1–S6 邊想邊說記錄：AI 輔助解題時的三步、五格與三個追問句（數學）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/think-aloud-record-ai-assisted-solve/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 解題時用了工具，最後只交一個答案——教師看不到哪一步是學生想的、哪一步是工具給的。這一頁用三步（先想、邊做邊說、回頭對照）、五格記錄表與三個追問句，把思路留在紙上；教師只看五格，不看工具畫面。
- Stage: S1-S6
- Subject: 數學
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.0
- Sources: EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.1 s.4; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構（應用場景示例）》, p.13; 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, Supp. II; CDC Maths C&A Guide (S4-S6)

### P4-S6 Chinese Language: two drafts side by side — what changed and why (three columns, three self-assessment questions, one peer comparison)
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/en/resources/two-draft-comparison-revision/
- Language: en
- Description: Set the first and revised drafts side by side and record only three to five changes — where, what it became, and why — then answer three self-assessment questions and run one peer comparison, so a teacher can see the reasoning without reading two whole essays.
- Stage: P4-S6
- Subject: Chinese Language
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.0
- Sources: Supplement II: Guide to Using AI in Teaching in Primary and Secondary Schools, pp.2-7 to 2-8; Supplement I: AI Literacy Learning Framework for Primary and Secondary Schools, p.1-4; EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.2 item 4

### P4–S6 中文：兩稿對照——改了甚麼、為甚麼（三欄記錄、三問自評、一次同儕對照）
- URL: https://beets-ai.com/resources/two-draft-comparison-revision/
- Language: zh-HK
- Description: 把初稿與修訂稿並排，只記其中三至五處改動：位置、改成甚麼、為甚麼改；再加三問自評與一次同儕對照，讓教師不必讀兩篇全文，也看得見學生為甚麼這樣改。
- Stage: P4-S6
- Subject: 中文
- Theme: C (看見學生思考)
- Audience: teachers (教師), students (學生)
- Version: 1.0
- Sources: 《中小學應用人工智能教學指南》, pp.2-7 to 2-8; 《中小學人工智能素養學習架構》, p.1-4; EDBCM No. 156/2026, App.2 item 4
